instructions:
1. Stand about 60 cm in front of a chair, facing away from it.
2. Rest the top of your left foot on the seat behind you.
3. Place your right foot flat on the floor, a comfortable stride ahead.
4. Bend your right knee and hip to lower down, keeping your torso upright, until your right thigh is parallel to the floor.
5. Push through your right heel to stand back up.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your front knee tracking over your toes.
2. Brace your core to stop your hips from twisting toward the working leg.
3. Lower under control instead of dropping.
4. Lean the torso slightly forward to bias the glute.

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your left heel on the edge of a chair.
2. Lift your right leg and hold it bent toward the ceiling.
3. Place your arms by your sides, palms down.
4. Drive through your left heel and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips.
5. Pause at the top, then lower your hips with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze the glute hard at the top rather than arching your lower back.
2. Keep your hips level so the working side does not drop.
3. Brace your abs to resist pelvic rotation.
4. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
name: Chair elevated single leg glute bridge

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with both heels on the edge of a chair, knees bent.
2. Place your arms by your sides, palms down.
3. Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips.
4. Pause at the top with your body in a straight line from shoulders to knees.
5. Lower your hips back down with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze the glutes at the top instead of arching the lower back.
2. Keep your heels firmly planted on the chair.
3. Move slowly to keep tension on the glutes.
4. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
name: Chair feet elevated glute bridge

instructions:
1. Lie on your back with your heels on the edge of a chair.
2. Bring the soles of your feet together and let your knees fall out to the sides.
3. Place your arms by your sides, palms down.
4. Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips.
5. Pause at the top, then lower your hips with control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your knees pushed out to keep tension on the glutes.
2. Squeeze the glutes at the top instead of arching the lower back.
3. Keep your heels planted on the chair throughout.
4. Exhale as you lift, inhale as you lower.
name: Chair frog feet elevated glute bridge bodyweight
